subcategory_text: Mechanisms (e.g., notices, internal or public reports) for communicating data processing purposes, practices, associated privacy risks, and options for enabling individuals’ data processing preferences and requests are established and in place.
informative_references: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5: AC-8, IP-3 (Individual Participation)
implementation_examples: Provide accessible mechanisms (notices in product, on web, on device, on paper) to communicate purposes, practices, risks, and options for individuals to exercise data-processing preferences
Localise and translate notices for the user populations served
Capture acknowledgement records where required by law
assessment_objectives: Determine whether notices exist for data-processing purposes, practices, risks, and preferences
Determine whether the notices are accessible to the populations served
Determine whether the notices reflect current practices
Determine whether acknowledgements are captured where required
